body:
Before this commit a lot of needed dependencies were installed at the
root level to avoid repeating them. This leads to issues in linting but
also in running the examples because some dependencies were not linked
properly.

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito, @mthuret and @LukyVj to be potential reviewers
I relaunched the test but I'm not confident it will make things better :(

title: chore(deps): Put dependencies exactly where they need to be
